title: Soft Glowing Phone Wallpaper
tests: Tests delivery of a genuinely animated seamless portrait wallpaper with a clock-safe composition, not a landscape clip padded into a phone frame.

judge.summary: The wallpaper shows soft blue and purple ribbons shifting across a dark portrait canvas with ample clock space, though seamless looping and silence cannot be verified from still frames.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is an 8-second portrait 9:16 video, with artwork filling the frame rather than a landscape image surrounded by bars.
must_haves.why: The clip is identified as eight seconds long, and the supplied frames show a full-frame approximately 9:16 portrait composition without bars.

must_haves.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly against a dark background.
must_haves.why: The soft, luminous blue and purple ribbons change curvature and position gradually across the sampled timestamps against a black background.

must_haves.item: The top third stays mostly dark and uncluttered throughout, with the brightest ribbons concentrated lower down.
must_haves.why: Every supplied frame has a clear black top third, with the glowing ribbons confined to the lower portion.

must_haves.item: Repeated playback has no visible jump, flash or abrupt reset at the loop boundary.
must_haves.why: The one- and seven-second frames have similar compositions, but the actual end-to-start transition is not shown.

must_haves.item: There are no words, clock graphics or other interface elements baked into the video.
must_haves.why: No text, clocks, or interface graphics appear in any supplied frame.

must_haves.item: The video has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: Still frames provide no evidence about the audio track.
